text:
{
  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "FY26 revenue growth guidance of 3% to 3.5% in constant currency.",
      "made_in": "Jan 2026",
      "quote": "The new revenue growth guidance for this financial year is 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency.",
      "outcome": "Delivered 3.1% full year revenue growth for FY26 as reported in the April 2026 call.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Apr 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "FY26 operating margin guidance of 20% to 22%.",
      "made_in": "Jan 2026",
      "quote": "Our operating margin guidance for the financial year remains the same at 20% to 22%.",
      "outcome": "Full year margins for FY26 were 21% as reported in April 2026.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Apr 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Recruit 20,000 college graduates in FY26.",
      "made_in": "Feb 2026",
      "quote": "And next financial year, we also have a plan to recruit 20,000 college graduates",
      "outcome": "Full year net fresher hiring for FY26 was more than 20,000.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Apr 2026 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "FY27 revenue growth guidance of 1.5% to 3.5%.",
      "made_in": "Apr 2026",
      "quote": "On the guidance of the revenue, Jayesh will give a little bit of the color with that acquisition what you mentioned, on the way we have made the guidance",
      "outcome": "Guidance was cut to 1.5%-3% in July and further to 1%-2% in October 2026 due to sector softness.",
      "verdict": "missed",
      "evidence_source": "Jul 2026 and Oct 2026 calls"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Deliver 20% to 22% margin in FY27.",
      "made_in": "Apr 2026",
      "quote": "But this year we are confident of delivering 20% to 22%.",
      "outcome": "Tracking at 21.1% in Q1 and 21% in Q2 FY27; quarterly table shows 24% OPM for Sep 2026.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Jul 2026 / Oct 2026 calls and Sep 2026 Quarterly results"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Hire at least 20,000 freshers in FY27.",
      "made_in": "Apr 2026",
      "quote": "This year also, we are expecting at least 20,000 freshers to be hired.",
      "outcome": "Management reaffirmed the target of approximately 20,000 college graduates in the October 2026 call.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Oct 2026 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "6,000 Frontier Engineers over the next few years.",
      "made_in": "Jul 2026",
      "quote": "Our plan is to have 6,000 Frontier Engineers over the next few years.",
      "outcome": "No specific progress update provided in subsequent reported metrics for Q2 FY27.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Oct 2026 call"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 3,
    "partly": 0,
    "missed": 1,
    "summary": "Management consistently meets margin and hiring targets but tends to over-promise on revenue growth, requiring multiple downward revisions within the same fiscal year (FY27)."
  },
  "narrative_vs_numbers": [
    "Management reports 21% margins in calls, while the quarterly financial table shows a higher 24% OPM for the same 2026 periods.",
    "Revenue narrative shifted from 1.5-3.5% growth to 1-2% within six months, citing sector softness despite rising absolute revenue in the table.",
    "Hiring narrative remains steady at 20,000 freshers annually, which aligns with the reported 'more than 20,000' outcome for FY26."
  ]
}
